source.author: verg
source.text: Quin et Marruvia venit de gente sacerdos, fronde super galeam et felici comptus oliva.
source.text_original: Quin et Marruvia venit de gente sacerdos, / fronde super galeam et felici comptus oliva.
source.text_english: And there also came a priest from the Marruvian race, adorned with leafy boughs over his helmet and with fruitful olive.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: quin et Cecropiae proles vacat Orithyiae, temperet ut tremulos Zetes fraterque ceruchos.
reuse.text_original: quin et Cecropiae proles vacat Orithyiae, / temperet ut tremulos Zetes fraterque ceruchos.
reuse.text_english: Indeed, the offspring of Cecrops is also free from Orithyia, so that Zetes and his brother may restrain their trembling oars.
